summary: Shifts wheel-state history buffers forward by one frame. Copies the current slot of the three scalar buffers (this+0x1C5C/0x1C64, this+0x1E38/0x1E40, this+0x1E3C/0x1E44) to the previous slot, then iterates 4 per-wheel history blocks starting at this + 206 dwords (byte offset 0x338), advancing each block by 281 dwords. Inside every block it shifts four dword pairs forward and copies a 32-byte (0x20) sub-record from result + 22 dwords to result + 14 dwords. Returns the pointer one past the last processed block.
